title: Women, Infamous, and Exotic Beings: A Comparative Study of Honorific Usages in Wikipedia and LLMs for Bengali and Hindi
findings: Deity entities showed the strongest positive association with honorific forms in both Hindi and Bengali Wikipedia articles, with examples including figures like Durga, Ram, and Brahma. Large Language Models like GPT-4o generally replicated this sociocultural norm, consistently applying honorifics to deities, especially in tasks where a name was provided.
